$comment: Policy of the single quality gate (agent 'quality-gate'). REQ-FUNC-117, REQ-FUNC-118, REQ-SAFE-052..054; HAZ-025; RC-122..RC-127.
STATUS: DRAFT, PENDING owner approval. Design: docs/iec62304/agent_platform/Quality_Gate_Design.md.

ONE implementation (sixth review of PR #81, G27): this policy is read only by backend/app/services/quality_gate.py; the browser holds no copy and shows the server's answer. agents.json records the SHA-256 of this policy (canonical JSON).

DATA RULE (REQ-SAFE-053, RC-124): no threshold or figure here may come from non-commercial data. The thickness band limits are the limits pre-registered in the Paper A v0.3 protocol and only NAME the band in a warning. Until a v3 evidence asset with a licence on commercial_licence_allowlist is set in thickness.evidence_asset (the hook, null today), the thickness check warns and never abstains.

vocabulary.$comment: First review of PR #81 (S1, S2): the series description is split into tokens on every non-alphanumeric character (after splitting camelCase, '*' read as 'star', '+C' as 'postcontrast'); the class comes from the tokens, never from word-boundary regexes. Any other_words token, or a T1 weighting with a FLAIR name, is 'other' and ALWAYS abstains. Only a FLAIR, T2-FLAIR or dark-fluid name is FLAIR. Third review (G19): FIELD-AWARE - the description (SeriesDescription, ProtocolName, NIfTI descrip) by these tokens; the DICOM SequenceName by sequence_name_codes on its letters after a leading '*' (a Siemens prefix there, never T2*; an unlisted code says nothing); the DICOM ImageType by image_type_other (anything else says nothing). Corpus: backend/tests/fixtures/quality_gate/sequences.v1.json (G12, server test data). Second review (G15), restated in the fifth and made structural in the sixth (G27): this is the ONE sequence classifier, on the server only - with the gate on the RC-049 header evidence of the in-browser AI takes the class the server returns (with the gate off it keeps its base rules, G26; dataset_inventory is a research inventory that always keeps its base heuristic); TIRM is a FLAIR name; 'TI=' / 'TI:' in the text is an inversion time (seconds below ti_seconds_below).
vocabulary.$comment_weak: Fifth review of PR #81 (D-QG-12, G19 extension): a weak word (cal, loc, dir, mag: also a calibration, a location, a phase-encoding direction such as dir-AP, a magnitude image) makes the image other ONLY when the description names no FLAIR; every other word of other_words always does. With the gate OFF, the RC-049 header evidence and dataset_inventory keep their base rules (G26).
vocabulary.$comment_image_type: Ninth review of PR #81 (G33; D-QG-7, D-QG-11, D-QG-14 updated): ONLY an ImageType that says the image is not an acquisition makes it other (abstains): SECONDARY (made after the examination: a secondary capture, also DERIVED\SECONDARY), MPR / reformatted / RESAMPLED (re-sliced), MIP / minIP / PROJECTION IMAGE, SUBTRACTION, LOCALIZER, SCREEN SAVE and parametric maps (ADC, TRACEW, FA, perfusion, exponential). DERIVED\PRIMARY with on-scanner corrections (NORM, DIS2D, DIS3D, FILTERED, MFSPLIT) is the acquisition as the scanner delivers it: it says nothing and gives no warning. 'da-fl', 'dark-fl', 'darkfluid' and 'dark_fluid' are dark-fluid names (FLAIR).

mode_actions.$comment: G14 (first review of PR #81, C1): the physician's attestation is offered only in the modes of sequence.confirmation_modes; elsewhere the panel shows the action named here.
mode_actions.$comment_comparison: Third review of PR #81 (F1): the attestation is offered per visit in the comparison panel, so the comparison action points to it.

thickness.band_limits_source: pre-registered thickness bands of the Paper A v0.3 protocol (B1 <= 1.5, B2 (1.5, 4.5], B3 (4.5, 6.5], B4 > 6.5 mm); limits only, no figure
thickness.evidence_asset_hook: v3: the controlled-thickness evidence of paper 1 (commercial data only: DLBS CC0, MSLesSeg CC BY). When it lands, set evidence_asset to {asset_id, version, sha256, licence, abstain_band_ids}; a band abstains only when the licence is on commercial_licence_allowlist. Owner decision D-QG-4.

scanner.nothing_recorded_comment: Fourth review of PR #81 (R1): when NEITHER visit records its scanner, the gate only WARNS (scanner_not_recorded) and leaves the comparability to RC-062, which abstains exactly as on the base branch. The gate never removes an RC-062 abstention (G24).
scanner.source: RC-062 compare_acquisitions (backend/app/services/longitudinal_candidate_safety.py): text fields compared upper-cased with whitespace collapsed, field strength within 0.05 T
